aboutHeading: 25 Years of Electrical Excellence in Ivanhoe
aboutText: Established in 1995, Bone Electrical has been Ivanhoe's go-to electrical service provider for nearly three decades. As a family-run business owned by Peter and Damien Bone, we take pride in our reliability, expertise, and commitment to quality. Our team of accredited Master Electricians ensures all work complies with Australian standards, delivering safe and efficient solutions for homes and businesses.
servicesSubheading: Expert solutions tailored to your needs
servicesText: Bone Electrical offers a wide range of electrical services to meet the demands of Ivanhoe residents and businesses. From installations and repairs to safety checks and upgrades, our skilled team provides reliable and efficient solutions. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality workmanship and ensuring customer satisfaction on every project.

services.title: Residential Electrical Services
services.desc: Complete electrical solutions for homes, including wiring, outlet installations, and safety upgrades to keep your family safe and comfortable.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Services
services.desc: Reliable electrical systems for businesses, from office fit-outs to maintenance contracts, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Fast response for urgent electrical issues in Ivanhoe, available 24/7 to restore power and ensure safety.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: Enhance your space with professional lighting solutions, including LED upgrades, outdoor lighting, and custom designs for residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades & Safety Checks
services.desc: Upgrade outdated switchboards and conduct thorough safety inspections to meet current Australian electrical standards and prevent hazards.

services.title: Electrical Inspections & Compliance
services.desc: Comprehensive inspections for renovations, new builds, or compliance requirements, with detailed reports and recommendations.
